D/ [IMP] CAES VES[P A]VG P M COS ; R/ AVGVR TRI POT

A silver Denarius of Vespasian (AD 69-79), dating to AD 72-73 (Reece Period 4). Obverse description: Laureate bust right. Obverse inscription: [IMP] CAES VES[P A]VG P M COS IIII.Reverse description: Priestly indtruments.Reverse inscription: AVGVR TRI POT. RIC II, p. 83, no. 356
